name: @red-cup-engineering/public-personality-services-section
description: The Group's public personas, the accounts each holds, and her life through them. persona-new writes a new persona (her persona.json, her names on every platform and her address on the house's mail domain, and her author site); persona.json declares who she is and where she is present (a Neocities site, a Hive account, a Mastodon account, a Buttondown newsletter, the email address those need); persona-provision makes each presence so, asking the person at the node only for what a person must do; author-site derives her site's pages from persona.json and the house's records; persona-tend says a note in her voice when one is due (gated against the rules she keeps), carries what her site publishes to each account and records what reaches her there. Public receipts are kept beside the persona.

scripts.check: for f in src/*.mjs scripts/*.mjs test/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
